# `sendBookingConfirmation`

**Kind:** function tool — a background task
**Source model:** `grace_contracts.tools.messaging_tools.SendBookingConfirmationInput`
**Generated JSON:** `platform/vapi/tools/sendBookingConfirmation.json`

## What it does, and when Grace calls it

Text the booking confirmation. Call this after booking, rescheduling, or cancelling so the caller has it in writing.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type / allowed values | Required | Default | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bookingRef` | `string`, pattern `^[Bb][Kk]-[0-9A-Za-z]{4,8}$` | **yes** | — | Booking reference exactly as it was given to you, e.g. bk-3QR9. |

Any parameter not listed above is **rejected**, not ignored — the model inventing a field must be a loud error, never silent.

## Settings

| Setting | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Runs in background | **yes** | Vapi resolves it immediately and never returns the result to the model |
| Changes data | **yes** | Must be idempotent on `callId:toolCallId` (I3) |
| p95 target | — | A target for alerting, **not** a deadline — the deadline is `GRACE_TOOL_DEADLINE_MS` |
| Request timeout | 10 s | Above our own deadline, so our graceful sentence fires first |
| Retry | **none** | A retried write is a real duplicate — a second booking, a second text |
| Live Vapi ID | `e0f05ffe-bd64-494e-9c63-091817186ba3` | Vapi dashboard → **Tools** |
